name: ez-core
description: Core working skills: wdyr (researched recommendations), auto-run (work without stopping), ccf (group changed files into commits), check-code (DRY, SSOT and best-practice audit), short-message (plain-text message to send), olcm (commit messages for the current changes), refine-prompt (handoff prompt for a fresh chat from rough notes), continue-prompt (handoff prompt that continues this session's work in a new session), fc (Figma cache with a category index), clarify-work (verified artifact page to clarify issues and pending items), cr (reads a request back and starts nothing until acr), sql-query (permission-checked MSSQL, MySQL and PostgreSQL queries, direct or over SSH), ssh-cmd (permission-checked commands on a named server over SSH), freshsales (Freshsales contacts: search, details and events; delete only as a command for the user); a commit-message rule and hook: messages come only from olcm or ccf

research_command.title: wdyr research command
research_command.description: Command that saves each recommendation's research. wdyr runs it with `put <name> --new --file <file>` for a new note and `append <name> --file <file>` for the user's pick, and links the `page: <url>` line it prints. Leave empty to save only when your instructions name a folder.

org_repo.title: ccf org repo
org_repo.description: Repo that `ccf org` uses. Leave empty if you have none.

project_dirs.title: ccf project folders
project_dirs.description: Comma-separated folders that hold project repos, so `ccf <project>` finds <folder>/<project>.

daily_logs.title: ccf daily logs
daily_logs.description: Comma-separated globs with YYYYMMDD (e.g. time/YYYYMMDD.md). Today's file is left out of commits; earlier days are grouped.

audit_dir.title: check-code audit folder
audit_dir.description: Folder where check-code writes audit files when no audit command is set; <project> stands for the repo's folder name (e.g. /work/audits/<project>). Leave empty to write no audit files.

audit_command.title: check-code audit command
audit_command.description: Command that saves each audit instead of the audit folder. check-code runs it with `get <project> audits/<file> --out <file>` to read a document and `put <project> audits/<file> --file <file>` plus `--new` or `--stamp <stamp>` to write one. Leave empty to use the audit folder.

plain_letters.title: short-message plain letters
plain_letters.description: Write messages without diacritics (Romanian a, s, t instead of ă, ș, ț). Leave off to spell each language normally.

ticket_url.title: olcm ticket URL
ticket_url.description: Base URL put before a task ticket stored as a path (e.g. https://example.monday.com/), so olcm appends a full link. Leave empty to append the ticket as stored.

figma_cache_dir.title: fc Figma cache folder
figma_cache_dir.description: Folder where fc keeps cached Figma MCP responses and their index. Leave empty to use figma/cache in the current repo.

sql_connections.title: sql-query connections file
sql_connections.description: JSON file with the named database connections. Leave empty to use ~/.config/ez-skills/sql-connections.json.

ssh_connections.title: ssh-cmd connections file
ssh_connections.description: JSON file with the named SSH connections. Leave empty to use ~/.config/ez-skills/ssh-connections.json.

freshsales_env.title: freshsales env file
freshsales_env.description: Env file with FRESHSALES_BASE_URL and FRESHSALES_API_KEY. Leave empty to use ~/.config/ez-skills/freshsales.env.
